outcome: Drawing or discarding a split card moves exactly one card.
Only the chosen half is evaluated for castability and put on the stack.
A split spell on the stack has only the characteristics of the half being cast.
A copy of a split card cast as a copy keeps the characteristics of both halves.
In every zone except the stack, a split card has the combined characteristics of its two halves.
A split card has the chosen name if either of its two names is the chosen name.
A split card outside the stack has the combined mana cost, colors and mana value of its halves, while the spell has only its half.
A split card has each card type and ability of both halves.
A fused split spell on the stack has the combined characteristics of both halves.
A permanent with a shared type line lacks the name, mana cost and rules text of each half that is not unlocked.
Both halves of a shared-type-line card have the shared types and subtypes.
A shared-type-line spell on the stack keeps both halves as copiable values.
A shared-type-line permanent enters with the unlocked designation of the half cast, or neither if not cast.
A player may pay a locked half's cost as a special action only with priority, an empty stack and a main phase of their turn.
Unlocking a locked half gives the permanent the matching unlocked designation.
Locking an unlocked half removes the matching unlocked designation.
A "when you unlock this door" ability triggers when the designation is given, whether on entering or later.
A "fully unlock" ability triggers when the permanent goes from one designation or none to having both.
